name: rtp-realpg
description: Drill-only real Postgres (embedded-postgres), kept out of the root package.json so Vercel never installs it. Install: npm install --prefix tools/realpg (never --ignore-scripts: the platform package's postinstall rebuilds its library symlinks). Pinned to 18.4 because production Neon is Postgres 18. Loaded by scripts/_drill/_harness.ts through createRequire.
